scenario.name: f05-gravity-turn
assumptions: Single-stage gravity-turn study of the F-02 reference plant and the F-04 tracker with the packaged illustrative spike_stage aero -- illustrative vehicle, not flight-certified.

Both models share the identical vehicle object, physics switches (US76 + J2 + rotation), ambient-corrected engine law, attitude program and RK4 core; the pair differs only in the 6-DOF content the attribution ladder isolates.
Constant full throttle until propellant exhaustion, then coast; throttle scheduling is guidance (F-06/F-07), not this study.

attitude_dynamics.description: rigid-body inertia + discrete tracker, aero off both sides (6dof_ideal - 3dof_vacuum)

actuator_lag.description: TVC first-order lag + slew limit on the aero-off loop (6dof_lag - 6dof_ideal)

aero_rigid_body.description: body-oriented aero on the lagged 6-DOF loop (6dof_full - 6dof_lag)

aero_point_mass.description: drag/lift carried by the 3-DOF baseline, the headline's counter-term (3dof_aero - 3dof_vacuum)
